registryAssessment: HM Land Registry publishes the INSPIRE Index Polygons open dataset as per-local-authority files for registered freehold property locations in England and Wales. The dataset is city-relevant by local-authority partition, but this review did not retrieve Newcastle’s file or inspect its feature schema.

officialPrimarySources.observation: HM Land Registry publishes the INSPIRE Index Polygons open dataset as per-local-authority files for registered freehold property locations in England and Wales. The dataset is city-relevant by local-authority partition, but this review did not retrieve Newcastle’s file or inspect its feature schema.

HM Land Registry describes INSPIRE Index Polygons as a subset locating freehold registered property and states that separate files are provided for each local authority; the dataset is OGL and updated 8 July 2026. Its official Download Service link redirects in a loop in the web reader, so no HTTP status, city-file URL, feature schema, identifier, CRS, or geometry sample is asserted.

This is a concrete city-local land/property record service, distinct from the national HM Land Registry INSPIRE index dataset.
